name: @molecule/api-project-archive-object-storage
description: Object-storage project archive provider for molecule.dev — standard tar.gz artifacts of generic ArchiveParts (source, database dumps, git bundles: nothing privileged) persisted through @molecule/api-uploads under the storage id the uploads bond mints, verified by re-reading and UNPACKING the artifact (checksum, manifest, part count, parts digest). Deciding which files to archive is the caller's job (use git); the one refusal is a non-configurable .env guard. Size caps, zero external dependencies
